newsitem.title: FRANCE: French police defuse rudimentary bomb in Nantes.
newsitem.headline: French police defuse rudimentary bomb in Nantes.

text.p: Police defused a rudimentary bomb found on a camp-site close to a university campus in Nantes in western France early on Friday, judicial sources said.

The device, made up of two packs of TNT explosive, was hidden in a camper van whose owner called in the police at about one a.m. (0000 GMT). Police evacuated the site. There was no indication on who might have planted the bomb.
